text:p.text:span: TMC New System: Structure and Development Technologies

draw:text-box.text:p: TMC Process Modules
How the thesis system moves from upload and preparation to calculation, restatement, and validation.
Inputs
Source matrix, OTH, CRP, brand mapping, group country, and reporter list uploads.
Core processing
Prepare TMA and SAL, build adjustment outputs, apply split logic, and calculate total market.
Outputs
Restated result rows and a validation-ready reporting view.
Project pages mapped to this flow: Matrix Submission, Upload OTH / CRP, Pipeline Viewer, Total Market Calculation, Restatement, and TMC Validation Report.
System Stack Overview
The implementation combines a browser UI, FastAPI services, PostgreSQL storage, and automated cloud deployment.
Frontend URL: https://thesis-rust-five.vercel.app/
Repository: https://github.com/YanxiangDu2023/thesis
Database Tables by Responsibility
Instead of one large schema, the project separates reference data, uploaded source data, calculations, and report snapshots.
The schema supports both operations and auditability: each upload, run, and report can be traced back to a planning year and a source dataset.
Frontend-Backend Interaction
The browser initiates the workflow, the backend performs validation and calculations, and results are returned as tables and report views.

text:p.text:span: latest uploads, report rows, validation summaries, download results

draw:text-box.text:p: This separation keeps interface concerns in the frontend while centralizing business rules, persistence, and reporting logic in the backend.
Automatic Deployment to Google Cloud
Backend changes on GitHub trigger a trusted deployment chain from workflow identity to Cloud Run revision.

text:p.text:span: GCP trusts workflow identity, not a personal login

draw:text-box.text:p: Sequence: push code -> GitHub Actions authenticates with Workload Identity Federation -> build and push image -> deploy Cloud Run -> backend uses Cloud SQL.
Cloud Run Cost and Open Questions
The cloud setup is practical for a thesis prototype, but costs and unfinished business rules still require attention.
Operationally, the system should stay lightweight, avoid unnecessary heavy runs, and document unresolved rules clearly before any broader rollout.
Current notable open point from your notes: validation and non-reporter brand treatment still needs a final agreed business rule.
